items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: He's come out there most of the time he was with Ellis.

ctx.x: You know who Mr. Lopat used to play something like that? He used to play something like Mealy. On that order, Mealy Barnes. But just like Mealy, you know. He had eyesight, he had eyesight. But when I heard him play, that's what all he played. You know Mealy Barnes? Do you know him? I'm probably. He's not brown-skinned. He's not brown-skinned. He's not. I heard that name. Well he used to play with Chris Kelly and all those guys, but he was not steady with those guys. He played with them and all. He played with…

Yeah, but Chris when he came there most of the time he was with Ellis. My mother's great. He's come out there most of the time he was with Ellis. My mother's great. Chris Kelly? I didn't know they played together. He's come out there most of the time he was with Ellis.

My mother's great. I didn't know they played together. I didn't know they played together. I don't know, I may be wrong, but I don't think those two ever played together. Chris Kelly? Chris Kelly was selling his name? Well I didn't know him, that's what I said. Oh, Guy Kelly you might be thinking of. Who? Guy Kelly. That's what he was talking about. In fact, I didn't think Chris would play with Sonny Sommers. I didn't think it was two, I don't know, I may be wrong, but I don't think those two ever played…
